extension.description: Copy code references, review Git changes, and inspect Git Blame annotations, history, and commit changes.
configuration.title: vscode-toolbox-namewta
configuration.logging.level: Controls the minimum diagnostic log level written to the vscode-toolbox-namewta output channel.
configuration.webview.requestTimeoutMs: Maximum time in milliseconds that the Toolbox Webview waits for a tool response.
configuration.gitBlame.dateFormatStyle: Controls the date format in Git Blame annotations. The default YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm uses the local time zone of the Extension Host.
configuration.gitBlame.authorNameStyle: Controls how author names appear in Git Blame annotations.
configuration.gitBlame.mergeCommitLines: Shows annotation text only on the first line of each consecutive commit block.
configuration.gitBlame.highlightCurrentC: Highlights all lines owned by the commit at the cursor.
configuration.gitBlame.ignoreWhitespace: Ignores whitespace changes while calculating Git Blame annotations.
configuration.gitBlame.maxLines: Maximum document line count allowed for Git Blame annotations.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Copy Reference, the Toolbox UI, and runtime information remain available. Git Blame and Git Review commands require a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Copy Reference supports stable virtual resources. Git Blame and Git Review require a resource that the Extension Host can map to an executable Git repository.
